items.title: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate s, it paints them
items.summary: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate s the way other AI models do. Instead of computing pixels, the language model writes Python code that places hundreds of thousands of simulated brushstrokes on a virtual canvas, complete with bristle texture and paint application. A single photorealistic parking garage scene took roughly 700,000 strokes, according to Anthropic employee Jake Eaton. The article Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate s, it paints them appeared first on The Decoder .
